title: Proper flat right adjoints preserve support over complements of quasi-compact opens
statement: Let Y be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let f:X\to Y be proper, flat, and of finite presentation [def-weil-proper-morphism, def-weil-flat-morphism], and let a be the right adjoint to Rf_* on quasi-coherent derived categories [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image]. For every quasi-compact open V\subset Y with inverse image U\subset X and every Q in D_QCoh(Y) supported on the closed subset Y\setminus V, the object a(Q) is supported on the closed subset X\setminus U.

proof.text: Supply open derived models by nonempty_derivedOpenLocalization. Properness gives X quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and the inverse image U of V is quasi-compact. Apply global perfect open-support detection to a(Q); it suffices to kill the restriction of every beta:P→a(Q) with P perfect.

Transpose beta under adj to alpha:F(P)→Q. properFlat_derivedDirectImage_perfect makes Rf_*P perfect, and hF transfers perfectness to F(P) via local representatives. Apply case (i) of exists_perfect_annihilator to alpha and hQ to obtain I perfect and i:I→O_Y invertible over V, with its tensor action killing alpha.

Apply adjoint_tensor_annihilator_transport to obtain j:R→P restricting to an isomorphism on U and satisfying j beta=0. Apply the exact derived restriction functor L; functoriality and preservation of zero give L(j)L(beta)=0. Cancel the epimorphism L(j), so L(beta)=0. The detector yields all required zero stalks.
